unlisted_practices: Using an LLM with a medical-translator prompt and auto chain-of-thought to summarize and translate discharge notes into Spanish
Bilingual physician Likert-scale review of translated summaries alongside automated cosine similarity and compression ratio metrics

screen.reason: Evaluates the feasibility and accuracy of GPT-4o to translate and summarize English discharge summaries into Spanish using a retrospective dataset, rated by a bilingual physician, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
